title: Gaia-derived Magellanic Cloud isophotes
interpretation: Broad astrometric selections for morphology; not membership probabilities.

processing.background: median of smoothed pixels at radius >= 0.75 query radius

queries.adql:
SELECT
    source_id / 2199023255552 AS healpix9,
    AVG(ra) AS ra_deg,
    MIN(ra) AS ra_min_deg,
    MAX(ra) AS ra_max_deg,
    AVG(dec) AS dec_deg,
    COUNT(*) AS source_count,
    SUM(POWER(10.0, -0.4 * phot_g_mean_mag)) AS g_flux
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source_lite
WHERE
    1 = CONTAINS(
        POINT('ICRS', ra, dec),
        CIRCLE(
            'ICRS',
            80.8942,
            -69.7561,
            12.0
        )
    )
    AND phot_g_mean_mag >= 12.0
    AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 20.0
    AND parallax >= -0.5
    AND parallax <= 0.5
    AND pmra >= 0.5
    AND pmra <= 3.2
    AND pmdec >= -1.0
    AND pmdec <= 1.5
GROUP BY healpix9

    AND pmdec <= -0.2
GROUP BY healpix9
